language.name: Primmel
language.specification: MN 114, the Primmel Language Specification (v3.3 draft); the v3.1 clauses (DAT-01 to DAT-04) anchor to its clause 19, the v3.2 clauses (CON-01 to CON-09) anchor to the v3.2 construct clauses, PKG-06 anchors to the 2026-09-08 revision's composition rules (the requirement-namespace pin, C119), PKG-07 anchors to the v3.3 revision's declared namespace pin (the document_module namespace facet, C119), the v3.3 clauses (FWK-01 to FWK-15) anchor to the v3.3 certification-framework clauses, the v3.3 codec-closure clauses (COD-01 to COD-06) anchor to the batch-4 codec-closure clauses (C124–C129), the v3.3 evaluation/execution clauses (EVL-01 to EVL-13) anchor to the batch-3 evaluation/execution clauses (C130–C141), PKG-08 anchors to the v3.3 overlay deep-merge composition rule (C141), the v3.3 workflow-fidelity clauses (WF-01 to WF-04) anchor to the batch-5 workflow clauses (C142–C143), PKG-09 anchors to the license-facet clauses (the entitlement facet, smart TODO.external-refs/04), and all identifiers re-key to the specification's conformance clauses when it publishes.

areas.syntax: The document grammar: structure, identifiers, and the five entity kinds (requirement, conformance test, form, calculation, table).
areas.serialization: The codec rules: the re-serialization fixed point and the canonical emission form.
areas.checks: The constraint machinery: the rule-identified checks a conforming checker applies to a package.
areas.packaging: The package layer: the manifest, editions, version pins, layered composition, abstract imports, and requirement-namespace pins (derived and document_module-declared), the register overlay deep merge, and the license facets (the entitlement catalog key + the copyright holder, C144–C146).
areas.errors: The named error cases: structural parse errors, enumerated facet rejection, and the duplicate-identifier issue.
areas.dataspace: The v3.1 extension set (MN 114 clause 19): the dataspace construct, the policy construct, the trust reference, and the correspondence annotations.
areas.consumption: The v3.2 consumption set (MN 114 v3.2): the term alias family, the applicability dimension, the structured reference identity + edition lineage, units-typed quantities, and the verdict chain + instance-parameter schema.
areas.surface: The runtime surface: the enumerated vocabularies the toolchain's browser-facing module exposes as data.
areas.framework: The v3.3 certification-framework set (MN 114 v3.3): the participant-kind and governance-organ registers, the declaration constructs, the scheme architecture, the framework documents, the decision rules, the framework reference resolution (C120), the abstract-process facets and the process_model construct, the ISO/IEC 17067 scheme-type register, the document-module constructs, and the batch-2 reference resolutions (C121–C123) with the segregation kind-conditional XOR (C59).
areas.cod: The v3.3 codec-exclusion closures (smart TODO.roadmap/40 batch 4): the pair_list attribute block, the calculation variant, the formula_note register, the common-test-conditions register, the part-annex register, and the demo_world/storyline demo seeds (C124–C129).
areas.evl: The v3.3 evaluation/execution set (smart TODO.roadmap/40 batch 3): the identity_slot and aspect registers, the promise certificate projection and the promise_set register, the application_declaration, the calculation_context, the evaluation_dimensions and evaluation_profile registers, the certificate_template, the workflow_config, the verification_pathway, the selection rules (lab_selection_criterion, sample_selection_rule, specimen_governance_rule), and the test_report_skeleton / test_report_checklist registers (C130–C141).
areas.wf: The v3.3 workflow-fidelity set (smart TODO.roadmap/40 batch 5): the workflow-process facets (phase, the ordered guards, machine_steps, the clause-URN source), the exclusive_gateway edge cascade with the default-edge discipline and the workflow_stage register with its members-resolve legs (C142), and the approval provenance and reference resolution (C143).

layout.clauses.json: the clause map: one conformance rule per clause, with its area and check-rule identifiers
layout.corpus/cases.json: the case index: every case with its clause, polarity, kind, path, and expectation
layout.corpus/syntax/: single-document cases for the syntax clauses
layout.corpus/checks/: single-package directories for the check clauses
layout.corpus/packaging/: package directories (some multi-package composition scenarios) for the packaging clauses
layout.corpus/surface/: the exports probes for the surface clause
layout.runner/run.mts: the runner: executes an adapter against the corpus and reports clause by clause
layout.runner/reference-adapter.mts: the reference adapter: the primmel-ts implementation of the adapter contract
layout.docs/running-a-third-party-implementatio: the adapter contract and the conformance-claim rules
